summary: Completed CORRECTED audit harness with NamespaceProxy isolation. All 6 vulnerabilities confirmed with proper isolation. Fixed A01 packs escape, A05 sequential await, A06 wrong proxy, A02 barrier, A04 incomplete test.

critical_bugs.name: Retry idempotency violation
critical_bugs.issue: retry() returns existing ID without bind_start_alias. After retry completion, new start_key creates duplicate retry instead of returning existing one.
critical_bugs.impact: Users can create multiple retry attempts for same parent, violating idempotency guarantee
critical_bugs.test_method: Called REAL attempts.retry() with K1 (creates R1), K2 while active (returns R1), complete R1, K2 after complete (creates R2 - BUG). Used NamespaceProxy to prevent packs escape.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Uses NamespaceProxy to isolate all db writes including packs.seal

critical_bugs.name: Concurrent publication race
critical_bugs.issue: publish() inserts version row BEFORE CAS. Concurrent publishes both succeed, creating duplicate version rows with same version number.
critical_bugs.impact: Database contains orphaned/duplicate version rows, revision guard ineffective
critical_bugs.test_method: Called REAL content.publish() twice concurrently with ACTUAL content.get wrapper barrier. Both captured preimage, both inserted version rows, revision guard failed.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Uses ACTUAL content.get wrapper with Event barrier to ensure both threads capture preimage

critical_bugs.name: Lost updates in concurrent editing
critical_bugs.issue: edit_question() uses read-modify-write without revision guard. Concurrent edits cause last-write-wins, losing earlier changes to different fields.
critical_bugs.impact: Editor changes are silently lost when multiple editors work on same question
critical_bugs.test_method: Called REAL content.edit_question() concurrently on different fields with proper barrier. Editor 1's text change was lost, only Editor 2's topic change persisted.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Uses proper barrier to ensure both editors capture preimage before writing

critical_bugs.name: Unknown audience fails open
critical_bugs.issue: SetInput accepts any string for audience (no enum). permitted() only checks 'restricted', fails open for unknown values like 'private-typo'.
critical_bugs.impact: Invalid audience values pass validation and permit unauthorized access
critical_bugs.test_method: Called REAL content.create_set() with audience='private-typo'. Set created successfully. ACTUALLY called set_detail() after setting published - access granted.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Actually calls set_detail() to verify access is granted (previous test never called it)

critical_bugs.name: Lane overflow no drain
critical_bugs.issue: run_job() returns immediately when lane full. No semaphore waiters or auto-retry after capacity frees. Jobs wait for maintenance() (15min).
critical_bugs.impact: Overflowed jobs experience unbounded delay until maintenance runs
critical_bugs.test_method: Patched freeze_ledger to ASYNC function with Event. Used asyncio.create_task for first 2 jobs (non-blocking). Lane filled, third job queued. Released first 2, waited 500ms - third job NOT auto-retried.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Patches freeze_ledger to ASYNC with Event, uses create_task to actually hold 2 jobs concurrently

critical_bugs.name: Extraction destination fencing gap
critical_bugs.issue: require_lease() check NOT atomic with destination write. Stale worker can modify sets collection even if job CAS fails.
critical_bugs.impact: Lease check not atomic with destination write, stale worker can corrupt data
critical_bugs.test_method: Patched the EXACT object tejas.jobs.sets.update_one (not db[TEMP_SETS]). Injected lease replacement between require_lease() and destination write. Stale worker wrote to destination.
critical_bugs.corrected_harness: Patches the EXACT module reference tejas.jobs.sets (not db proxy) to intercept actual destination writes

passed_tests: A01: Retry idempotency - REAL attempts.retry() called with NamespaceProxy isolation
A02: Concurrent publication - REAL content.publish() called with ACTUAL barrier
A03: Lost updates - REAL content.edit_question() called with proper barrier
A04: Audience fails open - REAL content.create_set() and set_detail() called
A05: Lane overflow - REAL jobs.run_job() with ASYNC freeze_ledger and create_task
A06: Extraction fencing - REAL jobs.run_job() with EXACT module patch

harness_corrections.A01_packs_escape: Fixed by using NamespaceProxy that intercepts ALL db references including packs.seal. No real tejas_packs records created.
harness_corrections.A05_sequential_await: Fixed by patching freeze_ledger to ASYNC function with Event, using asyncio.create_task to actually hold 2 jobs concurrently.
harness_corrections.A06_wrong_proxy: Fixed by patching the EXACT object tejas.jobs.sets.update_one (not db[TEMP_SETS] which is different Motor proxy).
harness_corrections.A02_barrier_unused: Fixed by using ACTUAL content.get wrapper with Event barrier to ensure both threads capture preimage.
harness_corrections.A04_incomplete: Fixed by actually calling set_detail() after setting published to verify access is granted.
